answer: New identities cross a dawn bridge to enter: each locks a 70,000 POA bond, then may wander across work domains with the bond trail in tow. At each dawn the bridge draws a random sample who must show one proof of real work from an outside counterparty; a fake or missing proof burns the bond, half goes to the reporter, the identity is banned 14 epochs and its slot revoked. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 70,000 = 70,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one 70,000 POA bond once. The limit: dawn sampling checks only a fraction each epoch, so a patient fake can hide between draws.
